item.description: Two separate rearview camera recalls, as well as a windshield wiper recall, account for more than two million vehicles recalled in one day from the Blue Oval.

item.title: Official: Ford Mustang Dark Horse SC Pricing Starts Well over $100K
item.description: The Dark Horse SC will cost over $25,000 more than the car it replaces, the Mustang Shelby GT500, and the SC's Track Pack will require an extra $36,500.

item.title: Your Guide to Charging an Electric Car
item.description: Driving an electric vehicle is relatively simple; however, charging an EV can get complicated. From charging speed to charging-station etiquette, we've got answers.

item.title: Gordon Murray's T.50S Is Faster Around a Circuit Than a GT3 Car
item.description: Three-time Indy 500 champion and GMA development driver Dario Franchitti signed off on the car after crushing a GT3 benchmark around Bahrain's F1 circuit.
